test_init_dir: test the init_dir function that initializes a directory with optional appname for cache paths
test_remove_dir: test the remove_dir function that safely removes a directory and all its contents
test_clean_dir: test the clean_dir function that deletes expired cache files and empty directories by time interval
init_dir_with_appname: create a cache directory using init_dir with an appname to get a user-specific cache path
remove_dir_safely: remove a directory and all its contents using remove_dir without raising if the directory does not exist
